decks.notes: The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain tempo and disrupt opponents with efficient spells and creatures, while also applying pressure with aggressive threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to control the game through card selection with cards like Preordain and Brainstorm, while also utilizing counterspells like Force of Will and Stifle to protect its own game plan. Additionally, the deck includes removal in the form of Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to handle opposing threats. Finally, the mana base is streamlined for consistency and to support the deck's aggressive strategy.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble the Dark Depths combo using cards like Crop Rotation, Green Sun's Zenith, and Thespian's Stage. By combining Dark Depths with Thespian's Stage, you can create a 20/20 Marit Lage token in just a few turns, putting intense pressure on your opponent. The deck also includes cards like Knight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer to search for key lands, as well as disruptive cards like Endurance and Swords to Plowshares to control the board and protect your combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing Cloudpost lands to ramp up mana quickly and cast powerful spells like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Kozilek's Command. It also includes a variety of artifacts like Grim Monolith and Karn, the Great Creator to control the game and disrupt your opponent's strategy. The combination of cards like Trinisphere and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale can slow down your opponent, while cards like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Urza's Saga help you search for key combo pieces to seal the game. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient ramp and powerful threats.

The deck focuses on using powerful reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to quickly bring back high-impact creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Daze to protect the combo pieces and control the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's strategy, ultimately overwhelming them with powerful creatures and control elements to secure the win.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan while maintaining tempo by playing efficient creatures and spells. The deck focuses on early game aggression using cards like Orcish Bowmasters and Nethergoyf, supported by disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will. Additionally, having cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Brazen Borrower provides card advantage and flexibility in dealing with threats. The mana base is designed to support both blue and black spells, with plenty of control elements like Wasteland and Daze to keep the opponent on the back foot.

The deck revolves around using the Dredge mechanic to fill the graveyard with key cards like Narcomoeba and Bridge from Below, then utilizing cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Dread Return to quickly assemble a powerful board state. Cabal Therapy helps disrupt the opponent's plans while also enabling graveyard shenanigans. Other cards like Faithless Looting and Satoru, the Infiltrator provide card selection and filtering to keep the engine running smoothly. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of creatures and generate a winning board state through powerful combos.

This deck aims to quickly assemble a combo that allows the player to win the game in one explosive turn. By dumping the entire deck into the graveyard, either through self-mill or sacrificing creatures, the player can then use cards like Thassa's Oracle or Balustrade Spy to win instantly. The deck includes a mix of acceleration, disruption, and combo pieces to help achieve this goal efficiently. The key is to carefully plan and execute the combo while navigating through potential interaction from the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to use the Combo-Painter strategy to quickly and efficiently assemble the Grindstone and Painter's Servant combo. By utilizing cards like Goblin Engineer, Goblin Welder, and Fury, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent while setting up the win condition. Red Elemental Blast and Pyroblast provide protection and disruption against opposing strategies. The inclusion of cards like Ensnaring Bridge and Lightning Bolt help control the board and buy time to execute the combo. The deck's goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful and synergistic combo while maintaining control of the game.

This deck focuses on quickly putting powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty into the graveyard using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bringing them back onto the battlefield with Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect its combo pieces. The deck aims to outpace and overwhelm opponents by efficiently reanimating threats while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal. The mana base is streamlined to maximize consistency and includes powerful utility lands like Wasteland for additional disruption.

This deck is focused on generating infinite mana with cards like Grim Monolith, Basalt Monolith, and Voltaic Key to then use Mystic Forge to cast multiple spells in a turn. The combo pieces are supported by mana ramp cards like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal, along with card draw spells like Paradoxical Outcome. The win condition is typically achieved by using The One Ring or Glaring Fleshraker to deal massive damage to the opponent. The key strategy is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent before they can react.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing cards such as Swords to Plowshares, Force of Will, and Dress Down to disrupt your opponent's strategy. The deck also includes powerful cards like Phyrexian Dreadnought and Nulldrifter to apply pressure on your opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Torpor Orb and Stock Up helps to further solidify your control over the game. The deck is designed to maintain board presence and disrupt your opponent's game plan in order to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo using Mystic Forge and mana-producing artifacts like Grim Monolith and Basalt Monolith. The deck also includes key utility cards like Defense Grid and Karn, the Great Creator for protection and additional combo pieces. By efficiently ramping up mana and utilizing cards that enable card draw and recursion like the Soul-Guide Lantern, the deck aims to achieve a dominant board state and win condition through explosive plays and resource management. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Planar Nexus further enhances the deck's potential for explosive plays and consistency.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost, disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Daze to control the opponent's resources while deploying aggressive creatures like Nethergoyf and Orcish Bowmasters to apply pressure. Wasteland is used to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide card advantage and additional disruption. The deck aims to maintain tempo by efficiently answering threats and controlling the game's pace, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a combination of evasive threats and disruptive elements.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through cards like Dark Ritual and Lion's Eye Diamond, as well as using cards like Mox Opal and Chrome Mox to accelerate its game plan. The key strategy is to cast a high number of spells in a single turn to increase storm count, before finishing the game with Tendrils of Agony. The deck also utilizes cards like Echo of Eons and Entomb to dig for combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to win the game through a powerful storm turn.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures and disruption spells. By utilizing aggressive creatures like Ocelot Pride and Scythecat Cub, paired with removal spells such as Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent. Additionally, cards like Daze and Force of Will provide protection and disruption against opposing strategies. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student adds another dimension to the deck's game plan, allowing for card advantage and control over the battlefield.

The deck focuses on using lands and control elements to overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a powerful Marit Lage token, as well as Life from the Loam to recur lands and maintain card advantage. Crop Rotation and Expedition Map help find key lands like Bojuka Bog or The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale, while Wasteland and Ghost Quarter disrupt the opponent's mana base. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Malevolent Rumble and Mox Diamond for acceleration. Overall, the strategy revolves around controlling the board and overwhelming the opponent with powerful land interactions.
